name: dotnet
description: C# / .NET: xunit, NUnit or MSTest for the unit seam; WebApplicationFactory, TestServer or Testcontainers for integration; Verify/ApprovalTests for the golden seam; bUnit for the component seam in Blazor repos. Drop the seams your repo doesn't actually write — a seam name it keeps is a Level intake is allowed to promise.

seams.name: widget
seams.note: bUnit — Blazor's render-a-tree seam. Delete this entry in a repo with no Blazor components: an unavailable seam is honest, an absent one is invisible.
